title: AI Scientist ideate - v2 architecture contracts (slides 3-5)
note: Single source of truth for v2 identifiers, dependencies, gates, loops, artifacts and design verdicts. Implementation facts per Unit come from the legacy registry through contracts/legacy_snapshot.json. ARCHITECTURE.md and references/unit_contracts.md render their generated blocks from these files (scripts/render_docs.py).

provenance_labels.PPT: Stated on slides 3-5 of aiscientist_architecture (PDF export, sha256 cef8aa73...).
provenance_labels.PPT-OTHER: Stated on another slide of the same deck (slides 1, 2, 6-11); context only.
provenance_labels.IMPL: Verified in the legacy implementation (ideate_units.json, scripts/*.py, references/*.md) at the pinned hashes.
provenance_labels.INF: Inferred from the slides and the implementation; not stated anywhere verbatim.
provenance_labels.PROP: A v2 design proposal or decision recorded in this registry (see decisions).

retry_policies.applies_to: deterministic failures: input_contract, check_failed, environment, policy, schema of a script Unit
one network request inside a script Unit (rate limit, 5xx, timeout); a source failing twice running is benched and retried once (A2.s)
a model or subagent answer the Unit's tool rejects: the findings are fed back once
a fan-out batch (A3, A7.D, A7.X2) with no or invalid answer is re-dispatched once; a single invalid item is returned for re-scoring
re-running a whole Unit instance after its own retries are spent; never for deterministic failures
a gate's single forced revision (A1.e, the B5 gates): round 2 is final; the doubt is recorded

decisions.title: Build v2 in research_agent_harness; keep the legacy skill read-only
decisions.decision: The v2 contracts, MCP server, evals and scripts live in this repository (branch harness2). The legacy ai-scientist-ideate checkout is the implementation of every Unit and is not modified.
decisions.rationale: The legacy folder has no version control and carries a working, tested implementation; v2 adds the contract and orchestration layer around it.

decisions.title: Split the single source of truth
decisions.decision: contracts/*.json own v2 decisions (ids, steps, gates, loops, I/O artifacts, verdicts); the legacy ideate_units.json owns implementation facts, cached as a hash-pinned snapshot.
decisions.rationale: Avoids two hand-maintained copies of the same Unit facts; drift is detected by hash.

decisions.title: Identifier scheme
decisions.decision: Units keep their source ids (A1.p ... F.9, P1-P5); new units P0, B5, B6; substeps are <unit>/<label>; other entities use typed prefixes STEP-, GATE-, LOOP-, ART-, INFRA-, EXT-, STORE-, MCP-, RP-, D-, OQ-.
decisions.rationale: Source ids are already stable and used in code, fixtures and check-code namespaces.

decisions.title: A6 is two Units (A6.d fetch, A6.c convert)
decisions.decision: Adopt the implementation's split of the slide's single A6 card.
decisions.rationale: Different failure modes (network vs conversion), different resume points; legacy decision D6.

decisions.title: A5 stays one Unit with four route substeps
decisions.decision: A5/backward, A5/cocite, A5/forward, A5/similar are substeps (instances) of one Unit.
decisions.rationale: One owner of step2b_snowball_papers.json; the slide's two cards group the routes; legacy decision D6.

decisions.title: P0, B5 and B6 become contracted Units
decisions.decision: Question take-over (P0), the reflection rounds (B5) and finalize (B6) get Unit contracts here; registry cards in the legacy registry are a migration task.
decisions.rationale: Slide 5 draws them as steps with gates; without contracts they cannot be checked, resumed or traced.

decisions.title: v2 writes only under _state/errors/ and ERRORS.md
decisions.decision: The orchestrator never writes elsewhere in a research folder.
decisions.rationale: The legacy ledger refuses a Unit's done after writes outside its card, except under ignored globs (_state/errors/**, ERRORS.md).

decisions.title: One retry owner per level
decisions.decision: Transport retries belong to the Unit's transport, item retries to the Unit's tool, Unit re-runs to the orchestrator; a level never retries an error a lower level already retried.
decisions.rationale: Prevents multiplicative nested retries and duplicate side effects.

decisions.title: Fully automatic; people intervene through _human/ and ERRORS.md
decisions.decision: No human checkpoints inside a run; ask_human is not a valid error action.
decisions.rationale: Legacy decision D4; the four checkpoints of the original engine are replaced by rules and caveats.

decisions.title: A gate passes only when both checks pass
decisions.decision: Gate = legacy domain check (exit 0) AND v2 contract check (no ERROR). v2 never overrides a legacy ERROR.
decisions.rationale: The legacy checks hold the domain rules with counter-examples; v2 adds contract-level checks (states, artifacts, bounds).

decisions.title: Partial stale detection in v2
decisions.decision: v2 recomputes ledger hashes only for file, glob and step0 specs; basis/view/part specs are reported as not verifiable and delegated to ideate_tools.py status.
decisions.rationale: Those specs depend on legacy domain functions; re-implementing them would duplicate domain logic.

decisions.title: Declare A1.v as an upstream of B1
decisions.decision: v2 lists A1.v in B1.requires (deviation from the legacy card).
decisions.rationale: B1 and B6.3 read A1.v's keys but nothing guaranteed A1.v ran (validator C-IO-ORDER).

decisions.title: English for v2 artifacts; slide terms kept
decisions.decision: All v2 files are English; the Chinese slide names are kept as name_zh and in the glossary.
decisions.rationale: Requested; keeps traceability to the slides.

decisions.title: Slides 3-5 are the architecture basis
decisions.decision: Slides 2 and 6 describe the legacy (no-protocol) flow, which is frozen; where slide 2 disagrees with slide 3 (export before snowball), slide 3 holds.
decisions.rationale: Legacy decisions D1, D2; the implementation follows slide 3.

decisions.title: research-write is out of scope
decisions.decision: Manuscript writing moved to the writeup skill (slide 1).

open_questions.question: The .pptx was locked during analysis; the PDF export was used. Are there speaker notes or hidden slides that change slides 3-5?
open_questions.resolution: Re-run scripts on the .pptx with PowerPoint closed (pptx text extraction) and diff against the PDF.

open_questions.question: Legacy ARCHITECTURE_v2.md v0.4 section 8 says scholar_research/v2 (contracts, errors, agents, cli) exists; no branch of this repository contains it. Where is it?
open_questions.impact: If it exists elsewhere, the v2 orchestrator here duplicates it.
open_questions.resolution: Locate the code or record it as never committed; reconcile with ideate_v2.

open_questions.question: docs/decisions/PLAN_ideate_armor.md, PLAN_ideate_fusion.md and PLAN_ideate_planning.md are cited but not available.
open_questions.impact: The twelve conditions are known only through it_units.py; rationale for some rules is unverifiable.
open_questions.resolution: Add the decision documents to the repository or link them.

open_questions.question: Slide 4 states 'ready questions >= max(generations, 3) + 2' as an exit condition; the implementation reports a shortfall as a warning (Y09) plus a must-disclose caveat and fails only when nothing is ready. Which is intended?
open_questions.impact: Gate strictness; whether Stage B may start short of questions.
open_questions.resolution: Decide hard vs soft; the v2 gate currently follows the implementation (WARN) and flags the difference.

open_questions.question: A1.v is in step 'Define' on slide 3 but in block 'planning' in the registry, and no Unit or gate requires it.
open_questions.impact: B1 and B6 may read context that was never written.
open_questions.resolution: Accept D-12 (B1 requires A1.v) or add A1.v to align-check.

open_questions.question: P1-P5 are at maturity L0 (3/12) and P0, B5, B6 have no registry cards. What is the plan to put Stage B on the ledger?
open_questions.impact: Stage B cannot be resumed, made stale or traced like Stage A.
open_questions.resolution: Migration milestone M4 (planning on the ledger).

open_questions.question: LOOP-03, LOOP-05, LOOP-06 and LOOP-11 have no numeric bound.
open_questions.impact: A pathological topic could revise indefinitely.
open_questions.resolution: Set bounds (proposal: 3 revisions per target per topic) and enforce them through ideate_check_loop.

open_questions.question: Is Windows a supported platform? The legacy suite fails 18 of 495 tests on Windows 11 (CRLF writes, symlinks, unescaped backslash paths, POSIX-only fcntl in scholar_mcp).
open_questions.impact: A2.s pacing and A6.c conversion checks fail on Windows.
open_questions.resolution: Declare supported platforms; fix or mark the tests.

open_questions.question: it_ledger._append rewrites the whole ledger through a temporary file without a lock. Are concurrent Unit commands (e.g. B3.5 beside the R series) safe?
open_questions.resolution: Add an append lock (as ideate_v2 does) or serialise commands.

open_questions.question: references/planning/README.md lists K01-K10; the code emits K01-K11 (slide 5: K06-11).
No acceptance thresholds exist for the quality of model judgements (A1.e, A2.c, A3, A7.D, A7.X2, B3, B3.5, P1-P5).
open_questions.impact: Regressions in judgement quality are invisible.
open_questions.resolution: Build labelled datasets and baseline the rubric scores (evals/rubrics).

open_questions.question: Ledger done events record the model but not tokens or cost; budgets on the cards are estimates.
open_questions.resolution: Record tokens per Unit instance through ideate_record_event (UNIT_COMPLETED.metrics).

open_questions.question: The legacy archive (research_agent_v2, unpacked from a macOS zip) contains mcp/scholar_mcp/.env (1008 bytes).
open_questions.impact: API keys may be exposed if the archive is shared.
open_questions.resolution: Check whether the keys are live; rotate them; ship .env.example only.

open_questions.question: research-cycle.md section 6 still says 'return to B2 with a new angle' after B6; for protocol topics the next generation takes the next question (slide 5).
open_questions.impact: An agent following the text redoes topic-level work.

open_questions.question: B6.3 is the only networked step of Stage B. Is web access permitted in every deployment?
The planning acceptance (slide 5: blind review preferred the new version 4 of 4 times; T09 triggered 4/4 retrospectively) rests on four ideas.
open_questions.impact: Weak statistical support for the planning block.
open_questions.resolution: Pre-register a larger comparison (>= 20 ideas, paired, blinded).

open_questions.question: Should v2 events move from _state/errors/ to a dedicated _state/observability/?
open_questions.resolution: Requires adding the new path to the legacy IGNORE_GLOBS first.

open_questions.question: SPECTER2 (allenai/specter2_base) is not pinned to a revision hash.
open_questions.resolution: Pin the model revision and record it in done events.

open_questions.question: Slide 3: an unqualified single score is returned for re-scoring. How many times?
open_questions.resolution: Bound by RP-FANOUT-BATCH (max 2) unless the owner decides otherwise.
